user.title: Naolib Nantes Configuration
user.description: Pick a location on the map to search for nearby stops.

data_description.location: Move the marker to the area where you want to look for stops. Defaults to your home location.

data_description.stop_code: List of the closest stops, with their distance.

init.title: Naolib Nantes Options
init.description: Set how often the data is refreshed.

data_description.update_interval: Delay between two calls to the real-time API. The public endpoint is limited to one request every 30 seconds.

get_departures.name: Get next departures
get_departures.description: Returns the next departures of a configured stop.

lines.name: Lines
lines.description: Keep only these line numbers. All lines when empty.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Keep only one direction of travel. Both when empty.

walk_time.name: Walking time
walk_time.description: Skip the departures that can no longer be reached on foot within this time.
